shared_elements: repeated regular motifs arranged in registers/rings
justification: A depicts a radially symmetrical disc with a toothed/rayed rim, concentric rings of pierced openwork and a central schematic anthropomorphic or insect-like figure with a boss at its centre; B depicts a large rectangular rock-face panel filled with horizontal lines of inscribed script and no figural imagery at all. The only faint correspondence is the use of repeated, orderly motifs in bands or rings, which is entirely generic and does not point to a shared iconographic scheme.
